sources: recreation.gov search API (q='Sam Billings', campgrounds): no listing, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Single site $10 a night, additional vehicle $5. Pay in cash or check. Senior/Access passes halve the single-site fee only.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/sam-billings-memorial-campground ('Overnight Use: Single Site: $10/night. Additional Vehicle: $5/night.', 'Please be prepared to pay with CASH or CHECK.'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/sam-billings-memorial-campground ('consists of 12 campsites', 'Campground can accommodate RV's or trailers to 30 feet'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Three vault toilets. No garbage service: pack it in, pack it out.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/sam-billings-memorial-campground ('Three vault toilets are located throughout the campground', 'Potable water is not available at this site', 'Pack it in, Pack it out, no garbage service provided'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Site closed by snow annually.' No opening or closing dates published.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/sam-billings-memorial-campground (Current Conditions: 'Site closed by snow annually.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Camping limited to 16 consecutive days. The Forest Service page lists no reservation system (its Reservations heading is empty) and the campground is not on recreation.gov; pay on site in cash or check.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/sam-billings-memorial-campground ('Camping limited to 16 consecutive days.', 'Please be prepared to pay with CASH or CHECK.') + recreation.gov search API (no listing), read 2026-10-22

note: Bitterroot NF (West Fork RD) campground on FS 5731 off West Fork Rd, ~13 mi SW of Darby, near Boulder Creek. Picnic tables and fire rings, plus a large area for group activities. Boulder Creek Horse Camp (stock area) is across the road; no horses in this campground. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run (West Fork RD), first-come (no reservation system; not on recreation.gov). Confirmed $10 (+$5 extra vehicle, cash/check), 12 sites to 30 ft, vault toilets, no potable water, closed by snow annually, 16-day limit. Not stated: opening/closing dates, fcfs wording (left derived). Note trimmed of restated values.
